description: Das Glyptodon traded the round nose for a square jaw and never looked back. Long frame, long bed, a cab with corners you could set a ruler on, and a gearbox arrangement it will explain to you at length whether you asked or not. Armoured by temperament, if not by law.

real.description: A two-door truck of the 435 series with an angular cab on a 3.25 m wheelbase and a 1.86 m track, on 14.5R20 tyres (1090 mm across). Steel drop-side bed, black plastic fender flares, slatted black grille, black steel bumper carrying the headlamps, and a raised air intake on the right A-pillar.
real.basis: Modelled from photos and a dimensioned drawing: wheelbase, track, tyre size, bed length and ride height follow them.
